title: Yet they affirm true God-pleasing holiness in the regenerate
source_text: XLII. Caeterum minime negant, ut clarum est ex iis quae fuerunt ante exposita, in iis qui per Dei gratiam renati sunt, reperiri justitiam & sanctitatem veram; per quam sancti justique & revera sunt, & vere dici possunt, idque non solum coram hominibus, sed etiam in conspectu Dei, qui justitiam illam agnoscit & probat, ut germanam & syn-ceram, nec potest illam non amare, atque gratam habere, ut in qua virtutum ipsarum divinarum similitudo quaedam, & imago splendeat. Quapropter etiam Deus in ultimo judicio in quo homines misericorditer, & ex Evangelii foedere judicabit, non autem secundum legis praecise sumptae rigorem, renatorum justitiae & bonis operibus, glorio-sum & solenne testimonium perhibebit, & vitam aeternam illis benigne retribuet, secun-dum gratuita quidem Evangelii promissa, sed in quorum complemento justitia quoque divina elucebit.
pass_a_gloss: But they by no means deny, as is clear from what was set forth before, that in those who have been reborn by God's grace true righteousness and holiness is found; by which they both truly are, and can truly be called, holy and just—and that not only before men but also in the sight of God, who acknowledges and approves that righteousness as genuine and sincere, and cannot but love it and hold it gracious, as that in which a certain likeness and image of the divine virtues themselves shines. Wherefore also God in the last judgment, in which he will judge men mercifully and according to the covenant of the Gospel, not according to the rigor of the law precisely taken, will bear glorious and solemn testimony to the righteousness and good works of the regenerate, and will kindly repay them eternal life according to the free promises of the Gospel, yet in the fulfilling of which divine justice also will shine forth.
pass_b_english: They do not deny true God-approved holiness in the regenerate—real before God, imaging divine virtues.
In the last evangelical judgment God will solemnly attest and reward it with eternal life.

choices.why: Key lemma for De Justitia densify §1076.
